title: FoCLIP: A Feature-Space Misalignment Framework for CLIP-Based Image Manipulation and Detection
abstract: arXiv:2511.06947v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The well-aligned attribute of CLIP-based models enables its effective application like CLIPscore as a widely adopted image quality assessment metric. However, such a CLIP-based metric is vulnerable for its delicate multimodal alignment. In this work, we propose FoCLIP, a feature-space misalignment framework for fooling CLIP-based image quality metric. Based on the stochastic gradient descent technique, FoCLIP integrates three key components to construct fooling examples: feature alignment as the core module to reduce image-text modality gaps, the score distribution balance module and pixel-guard regularization, which collectively optimize multimodal output equilibrium between CLIPscore performance and image quality. translated_title: FoCLIP：一种针对基于CLIP的图像操纵与检测的特征空间错位框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2511.06947v2 公告类型：replace-cross。摘要：基于CLIP的模型凭借其良好的对齐特性，能够被有效应用，例如CLIPscore已成为一种被广泛采用的图像质量评估指标。然而，由于其精细的多模态对齐机制，这类基于CLIP的指标容易受到攻击。在本工作中，我们提出了FoCLIP，一种用于欺骗基于CLIP的图像质量指标的特征空间错位框架。基于随机梯度下降技术，FoCLIP集成了三个关键组件来构建欺骗样本：作为核心模块的特征对齐，用于减小图像与文本模态之间的差距；分数分布平衡模块；以及像素保护正则化——三者共同优化CLIPscore性能与图像质量之间的多模态输出平衡。这种设计可以被用于在各种输入提示下最大化CLIPscore的预测值，即使这些图像要么在视觉上难以识别，要么与相应的对抗性提示在语义上不一致……
tldr: FoCLIP提出了一个基于特征空间错位的攻击框架，通过特征对齐、分数分布平衡和像素保护正则化三个组件生成欺骗样本，能够在保持图像视觉质量的同时最大化CLIPscore等基于CLIP的图像质量评估指标的评分。
en_tdlr: FoCLIP is a feature-space misalignment attack framework that integrates feature alignment, score distribution balancing, and pixel-guard regularization to craft fooling examples that maximize CLIP-based image quality scores while remaining visually unrecognizable or semantically incongruent with the prompts.
